acceptance_witness_sources.new-api.sml:
val noffiPrepareVariadic :
  {symbol:RuneForeign.resource,abi:int,result:RuneForeign.scalar,
   arguments:RuneForeign.scalar list,fixedCount:int}->RuneForeign.resource = RuneForeign.prepareVariadic
val noffiCallbackStatus : {callback:RuneForeign.resource,reset:bool}->
  {rejected:Word64.word,first:RuneForeign.callbackFault option}=RuneForeign.callbackStatus
val noffiFaults : RuneForeign.callbackFault list =
  [RuneForeign.WrongThread,RuneForeign.NoActivation,RuneForeign.EntryDisabled,RuneForeign.EntryFailure]
fun noffiError action = (action();raise Fail "native operation succeeded with FFI=no")
  handle RuneForeign.Error error=>error
val noffiFirst=noffiError(fn()=>ignore(RuneForeign.openLibrary "libc.so.6"))
val noffiSecond=noffiError(fn()=>ignore(RuneForeign.openLibrary "libc.so.6"))
val noffiAllocation=noffiError(fn()=>ignore(RuneForeign.allocate 0w1))
val noffiCallback=noffiError(fn()=>ignore(RuneForeign.callback{abi=0,result=RuneForeign.Void,arguments=[],
  failure=RuneForeign.Default(RuneForeign.Signed 0),function=fn _=>RuneForeign.Signed 0}))
val ()=if not(RuneForeign.available()) andalso noffiFirst=noffiSecond andalso noffiFirst=noffiAllocation
  andalso noffiFirst=noffiCallback andalso #number noffiFirst<>0 andalso #native noffiFirst=0w0
  andalso #message noffiFirst="runtime built without libffi support" andalso RuneForeign.live()=0w0
  then Runtime.collect() else raise Fail "disabled operation is inconsistent or retains resources"
val ()=print "PASS disabled current API: variadic/status types, exact errors, no resources\n"
acceptance_witness_sources.sysnone.sml:
val _ : {symbol:RuneForeign.resource,abi:int,result:RuneForeign.scalar,
  arguments:RuneForeign.scalar list,fixedCount:int}->RuneForeign.resource=RuneForeign.prepareVariadic
val _ : {callback:RuneForeign.resource,reset:bool}->
  {rejected:Word64.word,first:RuneForeign.callbackFault option}=RuneForeign.callbackStatus
val ()=if RuneForeign.available() orelse RuneForeign.live()<>0w0 then raise Fail "sys-none FFI configuration" else ()
val ()=if #charBits(RuneForeign.abiFacts())<>8 then raise Fail "sys-none ABI facts" else ()
val ()=if (ignore(RuneForeign.openLibrary "unused");false)handle RuneForeign.Error{number,message,...}=>
  number<>0 andalso message="runtime built without libffi support" then () else raise Fail "sys-none unsupported native operation"
val ()=Runtime.collect()
